BrochureContent.Content:
A delightful & comfortable two-bedroom second floor apartment enjoying its own balcony & commanding wonderful views of the city skyline.
No. 1 Station House is a cute & cosy second floor apartment located within a stones throw of all conveniences! It is located 2 floors above Eddie Rockets looking towards John Street and the city beyond. Mac Donagh Junction Shopping Centre is located right on the doorstep and hosts many retails units, a supermarket, coffee shops, chemist, hairdresser, credit union etc. A short stroll will take you to High Street, passing pubs, Church, shops, river walks etc. along the way. Built in 2007 the apartment boasts many features to include two private balconies off the Living Room & Bedroom, amazing views of the city skyline, built in wardrobes to both bedrooms, master ensuite bedroom, elevator access & private car parking space to name but a few!

ACCOMMODATION
ENTRANCE HALL: 0.98m x 6.54m + 1.56m x 0.87m 
Complete with wooden floor, hot press and immersion and water pump.

BATHROOM: 1.83m x 2.47m with tiled floor, wc, whb, bath with mains
shower overhead & extractor fan.

KITCHEN / DINING / LIVING:
2.75m x 4.6m + 3.93m x 3.56m with tiled floor to the kitchen area and wooden floor to Living and Dining areas, spotlights, most attractive fitted kitchen units with appliances and tiled splashback. Breath taking views abound from the Living Room window and Balcony off the Living Room.

BEDROOM 1: 4.43m x 2.72m with triple built in wardrobes and window
with a view!

BEDROOM 2: 3.97m x 2.78m with  triple built in wardrobes, window with a view and small balcony.
ENSUITE: 1.26m x 1.71m with window, tiled floor, wc, whb, tiled shower cubicle with mains shower, towel radiator & extractor fan.

SERVICES:
Electric central heating, electricity, mains water and sewerage,
intercom access, elevator access, telephone & TV. 
There is an annual management charge of c. €2061.60
which covers building insurance, PL insurance, refuse & maintenance of the
common areas and car park.
Car park space 22. 

INCLUSIONS: Fixtures and fittings.
Gross Internal Floor Area of Apartment: c. 70 sq. m.
